skill.name: azure-role-selector
skill.description: Helps users choose least-privilege Azure roles for identities and generate assignment guidance using Azure MCP tools.
skill.summary: Selects minimal Azure RBAC roles and produces assignment guidance for identities.
skill.author: 7Spade

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only SKILL.md file. Manual review found no prompt injection or malicious intent. The skill uses Azure MCP tools to identify least-privilege RBAC roles and produce assignment guidance.

content.value_statement: Azure role decisions can grant too much access when requirements are unclear. This skill maps desired permissions to minimal roles and assignment guidance.
actual_capabilities: Identifies minimal Azure role definitions that match stated permissions.
Uses Azure MCP documentation to compare built-in role options.
Suggests a custom role definition when no built-in role fits.
Generates Azure CLI assignment commands through Azure MCP tooling.
Provides a Bicep role assignment snippet using Azure MCP schema and best practices.
limitations: Does not execute Azure commands or verify assignments in a tenant.
Depends on Azure MCP tool access and current Microsoft documentation.
Requires clear permission, identity, and scope details for precise recommendations.
Generated custom roles and assignments still need administrative review.

use_cases.title: Choose Managed Identity Access
use_cases.description: Select the least-privilege Azure role for an application identity that needs specific resource permissions.

use_cases.title: Review Access Requests
use_cases.description: Compare requested permissions with built-in roles before approving an Azure RBAC change.

use_cases.title: Prepare Infrastructure Changes
use_cases.description: Generate role assignment guidance and Bicep snippets for repeatable deployment workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Built-In Role
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with clear actions and scope.
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to let [identity] perform [actions] on [scope]. Use azure-role-selector to recommend the least-privilege Azure role.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Role Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of multiple candidate roles.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare built-in Azure roles for [actions] on [resource type]. Explain the least-privilege choice and note permissions that exceed the need.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Assignment Guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: For [identity type and name], [scope], and required permissions [list], recommend the minimal role and generate Azure CLI assignment guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Custom Role
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced case where built-in roles do not fit.
prompt_templates.prompt: No built-in role appears to match [permissions]. Draft a custom role definition, assignment guidance, and Bicep snippet for [scope].

output_examples.input: A managed identity needs read-only access to blobs in one storage account.
output_examples.output: The response names the closest least-privilege built-in role, explains the match, and describes the narrow assignment scope.

output_examples.input: A deployment pipeline needs permission to assign one role at a resource group scope.
output_examples.output: The response compares relevant role options, highlights excess permissions, and recommends the smallest practical assignment.

output_examples.input: No built-in role matches a short list of required actions.
output_examples.output: The response outlines a custom role approach, provides assignment guidance, and notes required administrator review.

best_practices: Provide the exact Azure resource scope, identity type, and required actions.
Ask for built-in role comparison before considering a custom role.
Review generated CLI and Bicep guidance with an Azure administrator before applying changes.
anti_patterns: Requesting broad Owner or Contributor access without listing needed permissions.
Applying role assignments at subscription scope when resource scope is sufficient.
Treating generated commands as approved production change records.

faq.question: Does this skill assign roles in Azure?
faq.answer: No. It generates guidance and commands, but a user or administrator must apply them.

faq.question: Can it recommend custom roles?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest a custom role when no built-in role matches the required permissions.

faq.question: What details should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the identity, resource scope, required actions, and any compliance limits.

faq.question: Does it support Bicep?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill requests Bicep schema and best practice guidance through Azure MCP tools.

faq.question: Is it limited to least privilege?
faq.answer: The prompt directs the assistant to prefer the minimal role that satisfies the requested permissions.

faq.question: Can it verify my tenant permissions?
faq.answer: No. It cannot inspect your tenant unless the connected Azure tools provide that context.
